title: KoreLumina — Master OS - Fixing Tailwind Runtime

messages.content:
# Verify the project starts
npm run dev
quote>

Bash# Verify the project starts
npm run dev
If your terminal shows quote> after pasting, it means the shell thinks you started a quoted string or unfinished command.
Fix
Press:
BashCtrl + C
Then run only:
Bashnpm run dev
Expected Result
You should see output similar to:
BashVITE vX.X.X ready in ...
Local: http://localhost:8080
or
BashLocal: http://localhost:5173
Next Step
Keep this dev server running, and in another terminal open:
Bashhttp://localhost:3000/builder?projectId=lumina-builder
This will load the imported Lovable project inside KoreLumina's Builder for the UI readiness audit.

Excellent. If the repository is cloned and running cleanly, you are in the ideal position to use it as a dogfooding project inside KoreLumina.
Current State
Source Repository


Existing GitHub repository is fully functional.


Local development environment runs without errors.


Build and preview work correctly.


Application logic is intact.


KoreLumina Goal
Import this working repo into KoreLumina so that KoreLumina can:


Read the project structure.


Detect framework automatically (Next.js, Vite, React, etc.).


Start the project runtime.


Render a live preview.


Allow AI edits.


Show diffs.


Apply approved changes.


Push back to GitHub.


This is the core dogfooding workflow and one of KoreLumina’s strongest differentiators.

Why This Is Important
Most AI builders only generate new code.
KoreLumina’s true advantage is:

Import any existing repo and continue development visually and with AI.

This allows users to:


Import Lovable exports.


Import manually coded apps.


Import Vite apps.


Import Next.js apps.


Continue development without rebuilding from scratch.



Production Workflow
GitHub Repo
   ↓
Import into KoreLumina
   ↓
Runtime workspace created
   ↓
Dependencies installed
   ↓
Framework detected
   ↓
Dev server started
   ↓
Live preview rendered
   ↓
AI proposes edits
   ↓
Diff shown
   ↓
User approves
   ↓
Files overwritten
   ↓
Hot reload preview
   ↓
Commit + push

Runtime Workspace Structure
runtime/
└── workspaces/
    └── default/
        └── projects/
            └── <projectId>/
                ├── package.json
                ├── app/
                ├── src/
                ├── public/
                └── ...
What is the task at hand?
